Neha — thanks for sending dates and the materials. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Unfortunately, we need to pause hands-on work for the remainder of Q2. The product team just reprioritized the roadmap to focus on an interoperability sprint and several senior engineers are traveling through May/June. Given that, the inference/LLM track has been deprioritized internally and we won't be able to hold the demo in the next six weeks.

Can we table the demo and pick this back up in early Q3? In the meantime, could you send a 1-page summary of the ROI case and a lightweight MAP so our procurement and architecture folks can keep this on the radar? Also, please add estimated token cost ranges for a 100k message/month profile — that will help the CFO we loop in later.

I know this is a shift — it's mostly resource timing on our side rather than a product decision. Will follow up if anything changes.

Thanks,
Samantha
Director, Product Strategy — Clinical Apps
Orion Health

Short plan ideas (suggested):
- Offer a short, self-serve package + a 30-minute async recording to keep momentum (no heavy SRE/eng time).
- Offer a $5k credit toward first month of Dedicated capacity or hosted committed spend as a gesture — helps procurement keep it on the roadmap.
- Provide a one-page ROI + token cost estimate for 100k msgs/mo (Dev: can you pull token-cost ranges from the Optimize tool and paste numbers?).

FWIW, I think this is salvageable — it's a timing issue, not a rejection. But we should be quick with an alternative package.
